description.value: A squat concrete navigation beacon built in 2264 on the basin's eastern wall and decommissioned in 2277 when the sector's beacon network was rerouted. Its dish is gone and its door does not close. It now serves as a dry store for rock samples awaiting a ship, and has held some of them for longer than it was ever a beacon.

notes.value: The oldest crate inside is labelled for a ship that was reassigned in 2281 and has not been in this galaxy since.
